molecules.name: Indican
molecules.atoms: 14 carbon, 17 hydrogen, 1 nitrogen, 6 oxygen. Drag, or use the arrow keys, to turn it.
molecules.note: In the leaf, colourless: indoxyl joined to a glucose.

molecules.name: Indigo
molecules.atoms: 16 carbon, 10 hydrogen, 2 nitrogen, 2 oxygen. Drag, or use the arrow keys, to turn it.
molecules.note: In the cake and on the cloth, blue and insoluble. Drawn from CID 5318432, the C=O form; PubChem’s main indigo record, CID 10215, files another tautomer.

molecules.name: Leucoindigo
molecules.atoms: 16 carbon, 12 hydrogen, 2 nitrogen, 2 oxygen. Drag, or use the arrow keys, to turn it.
molecules.note: In the vat, soluble and pale yellow: the alkali takes the hydrogen from each oxygen and holds the dye as its sodium salt; drawn here as neutral leucoindigo.
